subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should tool-title generation honor a cross-provider explicit `utilityModel`, or must this decorative feature be restricted to the session’s current provider?
rationale: Canonical utility-model behavior permits an explicit provider choice, while this PR promises that tool arguments never leave the session provider; maintainer intent must define the boundary before implementation and documentation can agree.

options.title: Restrict to session provider
options.body: Reject cross-provider utility models for tool titles and preserve the stated no-new-egress boundary.

options.title: Honor configured utility model
options.body: Allow cross-provider routing but clearly disclose the destination in config help, protocol docs, and Control UI docs.

options.title: Keep deterministic-only UI
options.body: Decline the model-egress and configuration surface and retain deterministic tool rendering only.

recommendation.title: Restrict to session provider
recommendation.body: Reject cross-provider utility models for tool titles and preserve the stated no-new-egress boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows this person introduced, removed, and now proposes the opt-in title path and its routing contract.
